home.heroBadge: For medical students in the basic-science years
home.heroSubtitle: Every concept on Why Medicine comes with the reason it matters and how it connects to the bigger picture, taught by practicing physicians in complete courses that cover your subject from first lecture to final exam.
home.heroNote: Apply to a course and start the same day you're approved.
home.manifestoLine: If a detail seems pointless, it hasn't been explained yet.
home.manifestoSub: Nothing on Why Medicine is "just memorize this." Every fact, down to the smallest one, comes with the reason it matters and how it connects to the bigger picture.
home.featuresSubtitle: Built from scratch for medical students in the Arab world, on one belief: when you understand the why, you never need to memorize.
home.feature1Desc: Video lectures, PDF notes, quizzes, and the Step 1 side of every topic. One tab instead of five.
home.feature2Desc: Every video and PDF carries the viewer's personal watermark, so instructors' work stays protected.
home.feature3Desc: Every lecture you finish is tracked, so you always pick up exactly where you left off.
home.feature4Desc: MCQ and short-answer quizzes show you what actually stuck, before the exam does.
home.feature5Desc: Every instructor is a practicing physician or academic, vetted by our team before publishing a single lecture.
home.feature6Desc: Every lecture comes with its own flashcard deck. Flip, grade yourself, and replay the cards you missed until they stick.
home.faqSubtitle: The things students ask us before they join.
home.faq1A: Every course includes video lectures, PDF notes, quizzes, and a flashcard deck for each lecture, plus progress tracking that syncs across your devices.
home.faq2Q: How do I get access to a course?
home.faq2A: Open the course page and click "Apply for access". The instructor or our team reviews your request, and the course unlocks in your dashboard once you're approved.
home.faq3Q: Can I study from any device?
home.faq3A: Yes. Why Medicine works on phones, tablets, and computers. For content protection, student accounts keep one active session at a time, so logging in on a new device signs out the previous one.
home.faq4Q: Can I download the lecture materials?
home.faq4A: Lecture PDFs can be downloaded with your personal watermark on them. Videos stream inside the platform only. That's part of how we keep instructors' content safe.
home.faq5Q: How do I become an instructor?
home.faq5A: Sign up with an instructor account and share your credentials. Our team reviews every application, and once approved you can create and publish courses.
home.faq6Q: Do I still need a separate Step 1 resource next to my university lectures?
home.faq6A: No. That's the point of Why Medicine. Each course already merges your university's curriculum with official Step 1 material, so studying here covers your college exam and the boards from one source.

home.insideSubtitle: Each course is a complete study kit, not just a playlist of videos.
home.inside1Title: Video lectures that respect your time
home.inside1Desc: Recorded and structured by the instructor, streamed securely, and watchable at your own speed.
home.inside2Desc: Read alongside the video, or download a personal watermarked copy to revise offline.
home.inside3Desc: Lecture and course quizzes graded instantly, so you find your weak spots early.
home.inside4Desc: Instructor-made decks for active recall. Flip the card, grade yourself, and rerun the ones you got wrong.
home.inside5Desc: Mark lectures complete and pick up exactly where you stopped, on any device.
home.insideMockQ: Which artery supplies the SA node in most people?
home.usmleTitle: Learn it once, for your exam and for Step 1
home.usmleSubtitle: Every course merges your university's lecture content with official USMLE Step 1 material, topic by topic. Study from Why Medicine and you're fully covered for both. No second source, no separate board prep.
home.usmle1Desc: Aimed at first-, second-, and third-year students in the basic sciences (anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology, pharmacology, and microbiology), not clinical rotations.
home.usmle2Desc: First we teach the concept the way your curriculum expects it. Then we reframe the exact same topic the way the USMLE tests it: the high-yield facts, the classic associations, and why they matter.
home.usmle3Title: No extra studying, just deeper roots
home.usmle3Desc: You're already sitting through the lecture. The Step 1 segment adds a few focused minutes that turn short-term exam knowledge into something that sticks all the way to the boards.
home.coverageMergedDesc: Merged, ordered, and explained, with the why behind every detail.
home.teachSubtitle: Why Medicine gives clinicians and academics everything they need to teach online, without the tech headache.
home.teach1Desc: Drag-and-drop your videos and PDFs, reorder lectures anytime, and publish when you're ready.
home.teach2Desc: Every student sees your content stamped with their own identity, so leaks trace back instantly.
home.teach3Desc: See enrollments, lecture completion, and quiz scores for every course you run.
home.howSubtitle: No paperwork, just a quick application.
home.step1Desc: Browse by specialty and open the course that matches your semester.
home.step2Desc: Add an optional note. The instructor or our team reviews every request personally.
home.step3Desc: Once approved, the course appears in your dashboard instantly. Study from any device.
